title: Review: post-fix audit of idempotent delivery + group chat fixes
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — No new auth surface, no wire format changes. The stale chatId doc (P1) is the most dangerous item: it will cause a future contributor to implement wrong behavior confidently. The two P2 correctness gaps (Peer/receipt test coverage, sender_msg_id NOT NULL) are low-frequency failure modes but have clear fixes. All previously identified P0 bugs are correctly resolved.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) did not trace ReceiptHandler implementation end-to-end — the auth check logic was inferred from prior review description, not re-audited in this pass; (2) outbox retry loop is large and the lock-poison paths were identified by the subagent but not independently verified line-by-line. Would raise confidence if: run cargo test -p kithd --features test-utils and confirm green, add Peer/receipt e2e tests and confirm they pass.
